facts.text: I am the biggest animal that has ever lived!
I swim in oceans all over the world, but not the Arctic.
I eat tiny shrimp-like animals called krill.
I take giant gulps of water full of krill!
When I was born, I was already longer than a car!
My calls are some of the loudest sounds any animal makes.
In summer I eat off California, then swim south for winter.
People stopped hunting us, and now there are more of us again.

toys.caption: I'm almost as long as two school buses!

toys.reveal: I have no teeth! I strain krill through my baleen.
